snippet.title: The King Is Watching - Release Date Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017931

The King Is Watching is coming to PlayStation 5! Rule by the power of your royal gaze in this roguelite kingdom builder. Your lazy peasants only work when you are watching, so keep an eye on production, train your armies, and adapt to unique events every run. 

Add the game to your wishlist now!

#ps5 #ps5games #thekingiswatching
